test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 01 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with most appropriate option:
This is by far the ___ performance we've seen from the team all season.
solution:
The correct answer is '**best**'. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
__ 
 
• The sentence is comparing the performance of the team throughout the season, and it indicates that this is the highest level of performance observed. 
 
• **Superlative adjectives** like "**best**" are used when describing something as the highest degree among three or more options. 
 
• Other options like "**better**" and "**most better**" are incorrect because "**better**" is used for comparing two things, and "**most better**" is grammatically invalid. 
 
Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**. 
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"This is by far the **best**__ performance we've seen from the team all season."* 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 
 
 
• **Option 1: "better"** is incorrect because it is used for comparative purposes, not superlative. 
 
• **Option 3: "good"** is incorrect because it is the base form and cannot represent the highest degree of comparison. 
 
• **Option 4: "most better"** is incorrect because it is a redundant and grammatically invalid construction. 
</ul
